did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Umm , Rachel and I were just discussing it
statements.chinese: 嗯，Rachel和我刚刚还在讨论这件事

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: and she actually had some very interesting insights
statements.chinese: 而且她确实提出了一些非常独到的见解。

statements.english: Well , go ahead Rachel
statements.chinese: 好的，Rachel，请继续。

statements.english: Uh , thank you Phoebe
statements.chinese: 呃，谢谢 Phoebe。

statements.english: Umm , well , what struck me most when reading Jane Eyre
statements.chinese: 嗯，说实话，读《简·爱》时最打动我的是

statements.english: was uh , how the book was so ahead of its time
statements.chinese: 这本书在当时是多么超前啊。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: If you're talking about feminism , I think you're right
statements.chinese: 如果你在谈论女权主义，我认为你是对的。

statements.english: Yeah , well , feminism yes , but also the robots
statements.chinese: 是的，女权主义，是的，还有机器人。

statements.english: Okay , so umm , since that video camera thing didn't work out
statements.chinese: 好吧，呃，既然那个摄像机的事情没搞成

statements.english: uh , I thought that I would give you just a little preview
statements.chinese: 呃，我想先给你一个小小的预告。

statements.english: You're naked in this picture !
statements.chinese: 这张照片里你没穿衣服！

statements.english: I know
statements.chinese: 我知道。

statements.english: Ross
statements.chinese: Ross.

statements.english: Chandler
statements.chinese: Chandler.

statements.english: Monica
statements.chinese: Monica.

statements.english: Ross , are you okay ?
statements.chinese: Ross，你还好吗？

statements.english: I'm fine ! I saw a psychiatrist at work today
statements.chinese: 我很好！今天工作时去看了精神科医生。

statements.english: Why ?!
statements.chinese: 为什么？！

statements.english: On account of my rage
statements.chinese: 出于愤怒。

statements.english: Which I may say , right now , is out of control
statements.chinese: 可以说，眼下这已经完全失控了。

Which.definition: 哪个（关系代词，引导定语从句）

statements.english: He gave me a pill for it
statements.chinese: 他给了我一片药来治这个。

statements.english: - A pill ? - Uh-huh
statements.chinese: - 一颗药丸？ - 嗯哼。

statements.english: Well , when the psychiatrist told me I had to take a leave of absence
statements.chinese: 当心理医生告诉我必须休假时

had.definition: have（过去式）: 构成过去完成时

statements.english: because I yelled at my boss
statements.chinese: 因为我朝老板吼了一嗓子

statements.english: I started to get worked up again
statements.chinese: 我又开始激动起来

statements.english: so he offered me a tranquilizer
statements.chinese: 于是他给了我一片镇静剂。

statements.english: And I thought was a good idea so , I took it
statements.chinese: 我觉得这是个好主意，所以就采纳了。

statements.english: Wait a minute , they're making you take time off work ?
statements.chinese: 等等，他们让你休假？

statements.english: And you're okay with that ?
statements.chinese: 你对此没有意见吗？

statements.english: I don't know . It's going to be weird not having a job for a while
statements.chinese: 我不知道。一段时间没有工作会感觉怪怪的，

statements.english: but I , I definitely don't care about my sandwich
statements.chinese: 但我，我完全不在乎我的三明治。

statements.english: Ugh , that was so embarrassing !
statements.chinese: 哎呀，这也太尴尬了！

Ugh.definition: 表示厌恶或烦恼的感叹词

statements.english: I can't believe you let me go on and on like that !
statements.chinese: 真不敢相信你就这样让我一直说个不停！

statements.english: I'm sorry
statements.chinese: 我很抱歉。

statements.english: It was just so funny when you started comparing Jane Eyre to Robocop
statements.chinese: 当你开始把Jane Eyre和Robocop相提并论时，那场面真是滑稽极了。

statements.english: That was not funny !
statements.chinese: 这一点都不好笑！

statements.english: Well , I snapped ! Okay ? You weren't taking the class seriously
statements.chinese: 好吧，我爆发了！行了吧？你根本就没认真上课。

statements.english: Phoebe , come on ! What is the big deal ?
statements.chinese: Phoebe，别这样！有什么大不了的？

statements.english: I thought this was going to be something we could do together !
statements.chinese: 我本以为这是件我们可以一起做的事！

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: Y'know , I thought it would be fun !
statements.chinese: 要知道，我本以为这会很有趣！

statements.english: Well , yeah ! Fun is good , but y'know I also wanted to learn
statements.chinese: 当然啦！开心固然重要，不过你知道我也确实想学点东西。

statements.english: Y'know , people are always talking about
statements.chinese: 要知道，人们总在谈论

are.definition: be（现在时复数）: 构成进行时

statements.english: what they learned in high school and I never went to high school
statements.chinese: 他们在高中学到的东西，而我从未上过高中。

statements.english: Oh , so you really wanted to learn
statements.chinese: 哦，原来你是真心想学啊。

statements.english: Yeah , y'know , Pheebs I just wanted to have fun
statements.chinese: 是啊，你知道的，Pheebs，我只是想找点乐子。

statements.english: Ohh , you know who you should go with ?
statements.chinese: 哦，你知道该和谁一起去吗？

statements.english: I know ! I know ! I know !
statements.chinese: 我知道！我知道！我知道！

statements.english: Monica , you asked the question
statements.chinese: Monica，是你提的问题。

statements.english: Oh my God ! That's Monica !!
statements.chinese: 天啊！那是Monica！！

statements.english: Oh no-no-no ! No-no-no-no-no-no-no !
statements.chinese: 哦不不不！不不不不不不！

statements.english: You get away from me !! You sick , sick , sick , sick-o !!
statements.chinese: 离我远点！！你这个变态、变态、超级大变态！！

statements.english: What's going on ?
statements.chinese: 发生什么事了？

statements.english: Joey has got a secret peephole !
statements.chinese: Joey有个秘密窥视孔！

has.definition: have（现在时第三人称单数）: 构成现在完成时
